Cityworks

GIS-centric public asset management.

Founded 1996
Pricing Model Enterprise
Deployment Cloud / SaaS, On-Premise

Overview

Cityworks, a Trimble company, is the leading GIS-centric EAM solution designed specifically for local government and public works. It leverages Esri's ArcGIS to provide unparalleled spatial awareness for managing infrastructure and public assets.


Visit Official Website

Key Features

  • Native Esri ArcGIS Integration
  • Public Works Management
  • Permitting and Licensing
  • Work Order Management
  • Mobile Field Execution

Target Industries

  • Local Government
  • Utilities
  • Public Works
  • Water/Wastewater
